question: Does scripture remain authoritative whether or not it appears reasonable?
premises: Scripture is well known in the world.
It may appear reasonable or otherwise.
It functions in domains of both knowledge and ignorance.
inference: Scripture's authority is established independently of whether it seems reasonable in a given case.
plain_english: Whether the well-known scripture in the world is reasonable or otherwise, it is an authority in both knowledge and ignorance; thus that is established.
